info.title: Stonewake API
info.description: Read-only API for Stonewake credit monitoring, entity risk, and country intelligence. Documentation and setup guides: https://docs.stonewake.ai. Access is arranged per customer workspace.

post.description:
Issue a machine key for this tenant. The response carries the plaintext
secret EXACTLY ONCE: it is not stored and cannot be shown again.

401.description: The session credential was missing or not accepted. An API key is refused here too, because keys work only on /v1 and the MCP server.

403.description: The signed in person is no workspace administrator, the request came from a framed page, or, on creation, API access is not enabled for the workspace.

422.description: The request failed validation. A body field the schema refuses answers the validation body; an expiry without a time zone or in the past, and a team that is not one of the workspace's, answer one sentence in detail.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

429.description: The signed in person's minute ceiling was reached. Retry after the seconds in Retry-After.

503.description: The request could not be served safely, for example because the minute ceiling could not be counted. Retry with backoff.

get.description:
This tenant's keys, newest first: metadata only, revoked ones included
(the audit-friendly full history; nothing is ever deleted), plus the
workspace's API-access status. Served to unentitled tenants too: visibility
of existing keys is never gated.

request). Idempotent: an already-revoked key keeps its original timestamp
and writes no second audit row. Rows are never deleted.

test_receiver_only.description: Teams and webhook only. This workspace delivers to the Stonewake test receiver only.

channels.title: Channels

report_downloads.description: True gives the key the reports scope, so it may also download the report and committee pack PDFs of what it reads.

api_access_expires_at.title: Api Access Expires At
api_access_expires_at.description: When API access ends, set only while access is active and carries an end date, otherwise null.

workspace's read of the entitlement. `api_access_expires_at` (the trial

would mislead.

amber.title: Amber
amber.description: Points for an amber band, 0 to 100.

red.title: Red
red.description: Points for a red band, 0 to 100.

BandPoints.title: BandPoints
BandPoints.description: Band -> points on the 0-100 risk scale (higher points = worse).

cet1_amber_at.title: Cet1 Amber At
cet1_amber_at.description: The CET1 ratio at or below which a guarantor bank reads amber, as a fraction.

cet1_red_at.title: Cet1 Red At
cet1_red_at.description: The CET1 ratio at or below which it reads red, as a fraction.

npl_amber_at.title: Npl Amber At
npl_amber_at.description: The non performing loan ratio at or above which it reads amber, as a fraction.

npl_red_at.title: Npl Red At
npl_red_at.description: The non performing loan ratio at or above which it reads red, as a fraction.

BankHealthConfig.title: BankHealthConfig
BankHealthConfig.description:
Guarantor bank-health bands over the EBA transparency exercise ratios
(both fractions; at-or-beyond semantics, the band_from_edges convention).
Defaults, each justified against the TE2025 edition (119 banks, reference
2025-06-30) and the regulatory floors; config owns these numbers:

* CET1 (lower is worse): amber at or below 14%, red at or below 12%. The
  binding CET1 stack for a typical EU bank (4.5% Pillar 1 + 2.5% capital
  conservation buffer + the CET1 share of P2R and systemic/countercyclical
  buffers) puts the MDA trigger around 9-11%, so 12% means the management
  buffer over the distribution-restriction line has thinned to roughly a
  point, and 12% is below EVERY bank in TE2025 (sample minimum 12.25%).
  14% is the sample's bottom decile (p10 13.8%, 13 of 119 banks below):
  a guarantor bank there is an outlier among EU peers, worth an amber.
* NPL (higher is worse): amber at or above 5%, red at or above 8%. 5% is
  the regulator's own high-NPL line (EBA/GL/2018/06 applies its NPE
  strategy requirements to banks at or above a 5% gross NPL ratio) and
  sits past the sample's p95 (4.6%; 5 of 107 banks above 5%). 8% is
  roughly four times the TE2025 median (2.08%) and beyond every bank in
  the exercise (max 6.88%): asset-quality distress by EU standards.

at or above `amber_from` amber, else green. Below `min_completeness` of the
REACHABLE share (v25: evidenced plus register-quiet weight over the applicable
weight a source for the entity's jurisdiction can serve; conservative assumed
rows never count as seen) AND with at least one open gap, the status is
`insufficient`, never a green built on missing data.

red_at.description: The value at or beyond which the signal reads red, null when it has no such edge.

SignalSetting.title: SignalSetting
SignalSetting.description:
One monitored signal's knobs. `family` names the family_weights entry the
signal rolls into; `weight` is its share WITHIN that family (None = equal
split across the family's enabled signals). `override` lets a signal act on
the overall status regardless of weights: `red_cap` caps the entity at red
when the signal is red (it can never be argued away by good fundamentals);
`amber_floor` floors the entity at amber when the signal is amber or worse.

factor_weights.title: Factor Weights
factor_weights.description: The weight of each of the five supervisory slotting factors, each between 5 and 60 percent.

counterparty_degradation.title: Counterparty Degradation
counterparty_degradation.description: Whether a weak counterparty can worsen the slotting category.

good_from.title: Good From
good_from.description: The weighted average from which the category is good rather than strong, on the 1 to 4 scale.

satisfactory_from.title: Satisfactory From
satisfactory_from.description: The weighted average from which the category is satisfactory, on the 1 to 4 scale.

weak_from.title: Weak From
weak_from.description: The weighted average from which the category is weak, on the 1 to 4 scale.

SlottingConfig.title: SlottingConfig
SlottingConfig.description:
PF supervisory-slotting knobs: factor weights over the five CRE33.13
factors. The EBA RTS
(Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/598 under CRR Art 153(9)) mandates a
weighted average of the factors with INSTITUTION-CONFIGURABLE weights, so
the weights are config, not code. Defaults are the neutral equal split
(20 each): the RTS prescribes no default weighting but Art 2(2) BOUNDS
every factor weight (floor 5%, cap 60%), enforced by the validator below;
within those bounds equal is the launch judgment, tenant-tunable like
every weight table.

`good_from`/`satisfactory_from`/`weak_from` are the category cutoffs on
the 1 (strong) to 4 (weak) weighted-average scale, at-or-beyond semantics
(the band_from_edges convention): below good_from the category is strong;
the launch defaults 1.5/2.5/3.5 round a half-grade toward the WORSE
category (an average sitting exactly between two grades never rounds
toward the better one). `counterparty_degradation` arms the worsen-only
counterparty overlay (slotting module); off, only origination grades score.

reachable_share.description: The figure the insufficient status floor reads, the weight share of the applicable signals some connected source can serve for the company's jurisdiction that was actually observed. coverage_line.title: Coverage Line
coverage_line.description: One to three plain sentences counting the signals, how many were covered, how many are gaps and why, and how many do not apply. Null when no stored row carries a weight.

no_status_reason.title: No Status Reason
no_status_reason.description: Why no status is stated where one kind of evidence decides it: no_accounts when the status is insufficient and no annual accounts are on record for the company (the accounts carry most of the corporate weight, so the register and screening rows alone never reach the floor). Null for every other assessment.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The rubric version that scored the run, null for the built in default.

engine_version.title: Engine Version
engine_version.description: The version of the scoring engine that ran.

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: True for the exposure's current assessment.

V1AssessmentOut.title: V1AssessmentOut
V1AssessmentOut.description: One assessment, a scoring run of the append only history, with its signal rows. coverage_below_floor is true when reachable_share sits below the floor of the team's active rubric.

node_id.description: The candidate company's node id.

label.title: Label

country_iso3.title: Country Iso3
country_iso3.description: The company's country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when unknown.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Up to three identifiers of the company, the LEI first.

V1BindingCandidateOut.title: V1BindingCandidateOut
V1BindingCandidateOut.description:

numbers (the LEI first, at most three), the identifiers a bind takes.

deal_followed.description: True when the deal is followed, which puts it first.

role.title: Role

name.title: Name
name.description: The party's name as the sources report it.

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: Two or more companies hold the identifier a person entered, so nothing was matched; those companies are the candidates.

flagged_identifier.description: The identifier a person entered that two or more companies hold, null unless the party is flagged.

dismissed.title: Dismissed
dismissed.description: A person already chose none of these candidates.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: The companies the party may be, each with up to three identifiers.

V1BindingPartyOut.title: V1BindingPartyOut
V1BindingPartyOut.description: One unbound deal party on the worklist.

csv.title: Csv
csv.description: The book as CSV text with the header identifier_type,identifier and optionally name,currency,limit_amount,drawn_amount; at most 2,000 rows and 1,000,000 characters.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Always true, because this route previews and writes nothing; false answers 422 naming dry_run. An analyst applies an import in the dashboard.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book the preview reads.

counts.description: How many rows of the whole file read each outcome.

offset + limit in file order; `counts` and `total` cover the whole file.

key.title: Key
key.description: The signal's key, as the signal rows carry it.

from_band.title: From Band
from_band.description: The band before, null when it was not scored.

to_band.title: To Band

override.title: Override

citations.description: The records, events and screening assessments the signal cites.

external_id.description: The charge's key in the register, the company number and the charge code.

status_line.title: Status Line
status_line.description: The charge's status in the register's words.

security_line.description: What the charge secures in the register's words, null when it states none.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Register flags in words, such as a negative pledge or more persons entitled.

status_rank.description: 0 for a live charge, outstanding or part satisfied, 1 for a fully satisfied one, the order of the list.

created_on.title: Created On

satisfied_on.title: Satisfied On

lenders.description: The persons entitled the register states that a company node binds, each with its cited edge.

unmatched_lines.title: Unmatched Lines
unmatched_lines.description: The persons entitled the register states that no node binds, verbatim, served where person data is switched on and empty elsewhere.

citation.description: The register record of the charge.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The charge's classification as the register states it, null when it states none.

particulars_excerpt.title: Particulars Excerpt
particulars_excerpt.description: An excerpt of the charge's particulars as the register states them, null when it states none.

contains_fixed_charge.title: Contains Fixed Charge
contains_fixed_charge.description: Whether the register states a fixed charge, null when it states nothing either way.

contains_floating_charge.title: Contains Floating Charge
contains_floating_charge.description: Whether the register states a floating charge, null when it states nothing either way.

floating_charge_covers_all.title: Floating Charge Covers All
floating_charge_covers_all.description: Whether a floating charge covers all assets as the register states it, null when it states nothing either way.

V1ChargeOut.title: V1ChargeOut
V1ChargeOut.description:

register states and no node binds, verbatim, only where the workspace's
person gate is open (module docstring). Bound lenders keep their
drawer-ready cited edges.

records.title: Records
records.description: Each requested record id with its resolved evidence line, or null when it is unknown or may not be served to you, which read the same.

events.title: Events
events.description: Each requested event id with its resolved event and headline, or null when it is unknown or may not be served to you.

foreign-tenant, and gated person ids are indistinguishable by design).

unit_mastr_nr.description: The unit's number in the Marktstammdatenregister.

status.title: Status
status.description: The unit's operating status as one code, in_operation, planned, temporarily_shut_down or permanently_shut_down, unknown for a wording the register's list does not name.

status_label.title: Status Label
status_label.description: The status in English words, the register's own wording for unknown.

status_source.title: Status Source

bundesland.title: Bundesland
bundesland.description: The unit's federal state, null when the register states none.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: The register's address for the unit.

V1CollateralSiteOut.description: One MaStR unit with its register stated coordinate and its citation.

with_coordinates.title: With Coordinates

V1CollateralSitesOut.description:

unit records and how many of those state both coordinates at all.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

name.title: Name
name.description: The company's name, the same name GET /v1/portfolio rows serve as label.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Each field a register record states about the company, in the requested language: field (a stable key), label, value (the source's own words) and record_id, the record in identity_sources it cites.

identity_sources.title: Identity Sources
identity_sources.description: The register records the identity cites, each with the time its register last confirmed it.

risk_state.title: Risk State
risk_state.description: portfolio (your team holds the company; risk is its portfolio assessment), assessed (an assessment made on the spot for your team), in_progress (one is being made), not_assessed, or sole_trader (the register states a natural person's business, which is never scored; risk carries no assessment).

risk_reason.title: Risk Reason
risk_reason.description: Only with not_assessed: allowance (the workspace's hourly allowance of assessments is used up), failed (the last run did not complete and is paused) or not_started (none was made; an API read never starts one).

risk.description: The risk status. With locale de each signal's label, value_display and note read German as the German dashboard shows them (on a signal without data, note says why it has none), and the coverage_line reads German. Codes stay as served in every language.

officers.description: A Companies House company's officers: state on_record (count current appointments, checked_at the newest check), none_on_record (the register listed none when checked_at), reading (a read is queued and they follow in a moment) or not_read (an API read starts no register read). Null for a company without a Companies House number.

risk.description: The composite score with its breakdown, null when the country carries no score.

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.description: The cited indicator values of the country.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.description: The country's standing on the official lists.

events.title: Events
events.description: The dated list events of the country.

deals.title: Deals
deals.description: The country's live deals the Deal Book shows by default.

deals_total.title: Deals Total
deals_total.description: How many such deals there are.

deals_held_back.title: Deals Held Back
deals_held_back.description: The country's live deals the Deal Book holds back by default, counted and not listed.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The datasets that feed the country.

score.title: Score
score.description: The composite country risk score, 0 to 100, higher is riskier.

profile_version.title: Profile Version
profile_version.description: The scoring profile version, null for the built in default.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Each component the score is computed without, in breakdown order, with the reason no source fills it, stated once in plain sentences.

breakdown.title: Breakdown
breakdown.description: The score's components, each with its weight, raw value and citation.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The deal's id, the deal_id of every deal route.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The deal's name as the sources report it.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A short description of the transaction from its sources, null when none was written.

primary_country.title: Primary Country
primary_country.description: The deal's main country in words, null when no source names one.

primary_country_iso3.title: Primary Country Iso3
primary_country_iso3.description: The main country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when it could not be resolved.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Every country the deal names, in words.

countries_iso3.title: Countries Iso3
countries_iso3.description: Every country the deal names as ISO 3166 alpha 3 codes, empty when none could be resolved.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: The deal's sector, one of the values the sector parameter of GET /v1/deals takes.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The pipeline stage, one of the values the stage parameter of GET /v1/deals takes.

stage_confidence.title: Stage Confidence
stage_confidence.description: How sure the evidence that set the stage is, high, medium or low, high when an analyst set it.

status.title: Status
status.description: The analyst workflow status, new, tracking or dismissed.

relevance_score.title: Relevance Score
relevance_score.description: The priority the deal was ranked with, 0 to 100, read inside its score_window and never across the book.

contract_value_usd.title: Contract Value Usd
contract_value_usd.description: The Value's one amount in US dollars: in dollars as stated, else the dollar figure the source gives beside it, else converted at the ECB euro reference rates of 29 October 2026 or an official fixed parity, else at the IMF's dollar value of the SDR of that day (the African Development Bank's unit of account at par) or the US Treasury Reporting Rates of Exchange of 30 September 2026 or a later amendment of one of them, rounded to the last place the source states (GBP 82m serves 109000000, never 109198592.93) and never coarser than the Deal Book prints it. Null for a bound or a range, which contract_value_bound, contract_value_usd_min and contract_value_usd_max serve, for several amounts and for a currency without a rate. The Deal Book sorts and filters by the highest figure the Value states.

contract_value_bound.title: Contract Value Bound
contract_value_bound.description: at_least where the Value states a lower bound (exceeding EUR 1bn, more than SEK 100 million, EUR 900+ million), up_to where it states an upper bound (up to $1.1bn), range where it states two ends, null otherwise. A bound is never a point figure.

contract_value_usd_min.title: Contract Value Usd Min
contract_value_usd_min.description: The lower bound in US dollars of an at_least or range Value, converted like contract_value_usd and rounded down to the last place the source states, null otherwise.

contract_value_usd_max.title: Contract Value Usd Max
contract_value_usd_max.description: The upper bound in US dollars of an up_to or range Value, converted like contract_value_usd and rounded up to the last place the source states, null otherwise.

contract_value_usd_unread.title: Contract Value Usd Unread
contract_value_usd_unread.description: Why a reported Value has no dollar figure, each reason in words on the Deal Book page, one of several_amounts, price_per_unit, not_one_figure, no_currency, shared_currency (a sign or word several currencies share, such as Rs, P, lira or lei) or no_rate; null where it has a figure or no Value is reported.

contract_value_conversion.description: How the dollar figures were reached, null when there are none: basis stated_usd, source_usd (the dollar figure the source gives beside the amount) or reference_rate, the amount read as a plain decimal (a range's upper end, its lower end in amount_min), and for a conversion the currency, the rate as published, its quotation, its date and its source, and the place each figure is rounded to, so every figure is recomputed from these numbers alone.

contract_value_raw.title: Contract Value Raw
contract_value_raw.description: A reported amount with its currency as first reported, never a date, a tenor or a capacity, null when none was reported.

value_status.title: Value Status
value_status.description: confirmed where a verified quote states the figure, reported where no verified quote confirms it, absent where no amount is reported.

value_text.title: Value Text
value_text.description: The Value to print, in the currency the source reported it, with the limit word the quotes set before it, null when no amount is reported.

value_note.title: Value Note
value_note.description: The one sentence every surface prints beside a reported Value, null unless value_status is reported.

value_finding_id.title: Value Finding Id
value_finding_id.description: The linked finding whose verified quote states the Value, null unless value_status is confirmed.

value_basis.title: Value Basis
value_basis.description: What the Value is, financing, contract or unclassified, null exactly when value_text is null.

contract_value_finding_id.title: Contract Value Finding Id
contract_value_finding_id.description: The finding the Value came from, null when none did.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: One of the buyers the deal's parties name, null when none is named.

ecas.title: Ecas
ecas.description: The agency names on the deal under their canonical registry names.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: The agencies, one per institution under its canonical registry name, with its kind and roles.

exporters.title: Exporters
exporters.description: The exporter names on the deal.

lenders.title: Lenders
lenders.description: The lender names on the deal in name order. An institution agencies already lists is not repeated here.

first_seen_at.title: First Seen At
first_seen_at.description: When the deal first entered the book.

last_event_at.title: Last Event At
last_event_at.description: The earliest publication date among the fetched pages of the deal's newest reported event, null when no fetched page is dated. Never later than today in UTC.

dismissed_reason.title: Dismissed Reason
dismissed_reason.description: Why an analyst dismissed the deal, wrong_country, wrong_sector, too_small, not_financeable, duplicate, historical or other, null unless it is dismissed.

score_window.title: Score Window
score_window.description: The window the deal was ranked in, financing_open, early_stage, not_confirmed, financing_closed or cancelled, null when no ranking has scored it.

score_window_label.title: Score Window Label
score_window_label.description: The window in words, null when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_band.title: Score Band
score_band.description: The band word that goes with the score, null when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_reason_count.title: Score Reason Count
score_reason_count.description: How many reasons stand behind the score, 0 when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_hidden.title: Score Hidden
score_hidden.description: True for the rows a desk holds back by default, which the book serves only with include_hidden=true.

score_own_bank.title: Score Own Bank
score_own_bank.description: True when your own bank is named as a lender on the deal, read from the stored demotion.

state.title: State
state.description: The state the deal's linked findings confirm, null when no source's quote confirmed one.

state_label.title: State Label
state_label.description: The confirmed state in words, null when state is null.

event_date.title: Event Date
event_date.description: The newest event date a source stated in its own words, as a plain date, null when none was stated.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Why the row is on the desk's list, in the words of the desk of the team whose book holds it.

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: What is still to be financed, in the words of that desk, derived from the confirmed state, the window, the agencies and the lenders.

merged_into.title: Merged Into
merged_into.description: The deal this one was folded into after it turned out to be the same transaction, null on every standing deal.

from_pool.title: From Pool
from_pool.description: True on a deal of the shared deal pool, whose facts and research Stonewake keeps once for every workspace, while its status, its dismissed_reason and its next step are your team's own.

dismissed_in_pool.title: Dismissed In Pool
dismissed_in_pool.description: True where Stonewake dismissed the pool deal in the pool, because it was merged into another deal or set aside, so it reads dismissed in every workspace and can be neither reopened nor followed.

latest_update.description: The newest dated event on the deal's timeline whose quote confirmed a state, null when there is none.

has_unseen_update.title: Has Unseen Update
has_unseen_update.description: True when that event reached the deal after you last opened it in the dashboard, null for an API key, which records no opens.

q_matched.title: Q Matched
q_matched.description: Read with q, one entry per word or phrase of q the row holds, in the order of q, naming the first field that holds it, so a kept row says why it was kept, null on a page read without q.

score_breakdown.title: Score Breakdown
score_breakdown.description: The points each scoring component earned, by component name.

score_weights.title: Score Weights
score_weights.description: The most points each component can earn under the rubric that scored the deal, by component name.

score.title: Score
score.description: The priority the deal was ranked with, 0 to 100, inside its window.

band.title: Band
band.description: The band word that goes with the score, today Strong fit, Worth a look, Weak fit or Not a fit.

window.title: Window
window.description: The window the deal was ranked in, as score_window names it.

reason_count.title: Reason Count
reason_count.description: How many components stand behind the score.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: True when the desk holds the deal back by default, as score_hidden says.

component.title: Component
component.description: The scoring component, the name its points stand under.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: The most points the component can earn.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One plain sentence saying which fact the component matched, or that it found none.

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: False when the component found nothing, which is a reason in itself.

items.title: ScoreComponentShape
items.description: One scoring component's contribution and the fact behind it.

demotions.title: Demotions
demotions.description: The demotions applied, each a short phrase such as Country not stated, Own bank lends or No movement since 1 Apr 2025.

lowered.title: Lowered
lowered.description: True when any of the demotions lowers the score.

score_reasons.title: ScoreReasonsShape
score_reasons.description: Why the deal ranks where it does, as the ranking stored it, an empty object for a deal no ranking has scored. A row ranked before 20 October 2026 is served in the same short phrases.

next_action.title: Next Action
next_action.description: The analyst's own next step, null when none is set.

summary_lines.title: Summary Lines
summary_lines.description: Three lines generated from the cited findings by fixed rules, not by a model, each with its citations.

briefing.description: A quick summary a model drafted from the deal's own sources, with those sources, null unless it passed its release check.

parties.title: Parties
parties.description: The deal's parties, each with its role and the registry entry or company node it is bound to where one is.

unnamed_roles.title: Unnamed Roles
unnamed_roles.description: The role of the deal's cast no source names yet, exporter where neither an exporter nor an EPC contractor is named, else empty.

project_records.title: Project Records
project_records.description: The UK Renewable Energy Planning Database or EIA 860M generator inventory records of an energy deal's project in the United Kingdom or the United States, each with its status, planned and first planned dates, delay and edition, empty when no register holds the project or two projects share its name.

tracking_next_check_at.title: Tracking Next Check At
tracking_next_check_at.description: When the deal's daily check runs next while the deal is tracked, null when no check is scheduled.

tracking_scheduled_seconds.title: Tracking Scheduled Seconds
tracking_scheduled_seconds.description: How often research checks the deal in your workspace while it is followed, in seconds, also for a deal not followed yet, null where following adds no research check of its own.

dismissed_at.title: Dismissed At
dismissed_at.description: When the deal was dismissed, null unless it is dismissed.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: The linked findings, newest first, at most timeline_limit of them.

timeline_total.title: Timeline Total
timeline_total.description: How many findings are linked to the deal, whatever the timeline shows.

events.title: Events
events.description: The deal's lifecycle events, newest first, at most 50.

events_total.title: Events Total
events_total.description: How many lifecycle events the deal has.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The sources the returned timeline cites.

economics.description: The financing terms your analysts entered, null until any is entered.

desk_economics.description: The terms a project finance or real estate desk stores for the deal, null until an analyst enters any.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: The kind of lifecycle event, for example created, stage_change or status_change.

actor_label.title: Actor Label
actor_label.description: Linker, Synthesis or Research for a system process, null when a person acted. No identity is served.

from_value.title: From Value
from_value.description: The value before the change, null when the event changes none.

to_value.title: To Value
to_value.description: The value after the change, null when the event changes none.

finding_id.title: Finding Id
finding_id.description: The finding that triggered the event, null when none did.

Research; null = a human acted), never the acting identity or its note.

limit.title: Limit

total.title: Total
total.description: The exact count of rows after filtering, across every page.

movement_months.title: Movement Months
