outside_markets_held.title: Outside Markets Held
outside_markets_held.description: True where a team in scope holds back a row whose market lies outside its mandate, false where such rows stay on the page.

V1DealPage.title: V1DealPage
V1DealPage.description: One page of the deal book, beside the two age rules the ranker held rows back for, the stale window and the movement hold, in months.

role.title: Role
role.description: The party's commercial role on the deal, such as buyer, exporter, eca or lender.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Every role the party plays on the deal, in the desk's order, role the first.

name.title: Name
name.description: The party's name as the sources report it.

also_named.title: Also Named
also_named.description: Every other spelling of the party a source reported, in first seen order.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: The registry id the party is bound to, null when it is bound to none.

entity_display_name.title: Entity Display Name
entity_display_name.description: The registry entry's display name, null when the party is bound to none.

entity_full_name.title: Entity Full Name
entity_full_name.description: The registry entry's full name, null when the party is bound to none.

entity_kind.title: Entity Kind
entity_kind.description: The registry entry's kind, null when the party is bound to none.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company node the party is matched to, null until it is matched to a register.

V1DealPartyOut.title: V1DealPartyOut
V1DealPartyOut.description:
One party of the deal, once whatever spellings and roles its sources gave it:
role is its first role, roles all of them, name its most complete reported name and
also_named every other spelling a source reported.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The deal the rollup is for.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Every party of the deal and its main country, each with its latest screening.

unnamed_roles.title: Unnamed Roles
unnamed_roles.description: The role of the deal's cast no source names yet, exporter where neither an exporter nor an EPC contractor is named, else empty.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The deal's id, the deal_id of every deal route.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The deal's name as the sources report it.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A short description of the transaction from its sources, null when none was written.

primary_country.title: Primary Country
primary_country.description: The deal's main country in words, null when no source names one.

primary_country_iso3.title: Primary Country Iso3
primary_country_iso3.description: The main country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when it could not be resolved.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Every country the deal names, in words.

countries_iso3.title: Countries Iso3
countries_iso3.description: Every country the deal names as ISO 3166 alpha 3 codes, empty when none could be resolved.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: The deal's sector, one of the values the sector parameter of GET /v1/deals takes.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The pipeline stage, one of the values the stage parameter of GET /v1/deals takes.

stage_confidence.title: Stage Confidence
stage_confidence.description: How sure the evidence that set the stage is, high, medium or low, high when an analyst set it.

status.title: Status
status.description: The analyst workflow status, new, tracking or dismissed.

relevance_score.title: Relevance Score
relevance_score.description: The priority the deal was ranked with, 0 to 100, read inside its score_window and never across the book.

contract_value_usd.title: Contract Value Usd
contract_value_usd.description: The Value's one amount in US dollars: in dollars as stated, else the dollar figure the source gives beside it, else converted at the ECB euro reference rates of 29 October 2026 or an official fixed parity, else at the IMF's dollar value of the SDR of that day (the African Development Bank's unit of account at par) or the US Treasury Reporting Rates of Exchange of 30 September 2026 or a later amendment of one of them, rounded to the last place the source states (GBP 82m serves 109000000, never 109198592.93) and never coarser than the Deal Book prints it. Null for a bound or a range, which contract_value_bound, contract_value_usd_min and contract_value_usd_max serve, for several amounts and for a currency without a rate. The Deal Book sorts and filters by the highest figure the Value states.

contract_value_bound.title: Contract Value Bound
contract_value_bound.description: at_least where the Value states a lower bound (exceeding EUR 1bn, more than SEK 100 million, EUR 900+ million), up_to where it states an upper bound (up to $1.1bn), range where it states two ends, null otherwise. A bound is never a point figure.

contract_value_usd_min.title: Contract Value Usd Min
contract_value_usd_min.description: The lower bound in US dollars of an at_least or range Value, converted like contract_value_usd and rounded down to the last place the source states, null otherwise.

contract_value_usd_max.title: Contract Value Usd Max
contract_value_usd_max.description: The upper bound in US dollars of an up_to or range Value, converted like contract_value_usd and rounded up to the last place the source states, null otherwise.

contract_value_usd_unread.title: Contract Value Usd Unread
contract_value_usd_unread.description: Why a reported Value has no dollar figure, each reason in words on the Deal Book page, one of several_amounts, price_per_unit, not_one_figure, no_currency, shared_currency (a sign or word several currencies share, such as Rs, P, lira or lei) or no_rate; null where it has a figure or no Value is reported.

contract_value_conversion.description: How the dollar figures were reached, null when there are none: basis stated_usd, source_usd (the dollar figure the source gives beside the amount) or reference_rate, the amount read as a plain decimal (a range's upper end, its lower end in amount_min), and for a conversion the currency, the rate as published, its quotation, its date and its source, and the place each figure is rounded to, so every figure is recomputed from these numbers alone.

contract_value_raw.title: Contract Value Raw
contract_value_raw.description: A reported amount with its currency as first reported, never a date, a tenor or a capacity, null when none was reported.

value_status.title: Value Status
value_status.description: confirmed where a verified quote states the figure, reported where no verified quote confirms it, absent where no amount is reported.

value_text.title: Value Text
value_text.description: The Value to print, in the currency the source reported it, with the limit word the quotes set before it, null when no amount is reported.

value_note.title: Value Note
value_note.description: The one sentence every surface prints beside a reported Value, null unless value_status is reported.

value_finding_id.title: Value Finding Id
value_finding_id.description: The linked finding whose verified quote states the Value, null unless value_status is confirmed.

value_basis.title: Value Basis
value_basis.description: What the Value is, financing, contract or unclassified, null exactly when value_text is null.

contract_value_finding_id.title: Contract Value Finding Id
contract_value_finding_id.description: The finding the Value came from, null when none did.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: One of the buyers the deal's parties name, null when none is named.

ecas.title: Ecas
ecas.description: The agency names on the deal under their canonical registry names.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: The agencies, one per institution under its canonical registry name, with its kind and roles.

exporters.title: Exporters
exporters.description: The exporter names on the deal.

lenders.title: Lenders
lenders.description: The lender names on the deal in name order. An institution agencies already lists is not repeated here.

first_seen_at.title: First Seen At
first_seen_at.description: When the deal first entered the book.

last_event_at.title: Last Event At
last_event_at.description: The earliest publication date among the fetched pages of the deal's newest reported event, null when no fetched page is dated. Never later than today in UTC.

dismissed_reason.title: Dismissed Reason
dismissed_reason.description: Why an analyst dismissed the deal, wrong_country, wrong_sector, too_small, not_financeable, duplicate, historical or other, null unless it is dismissed.

score_window.title: Score Window
score_window.description: The window the deal was ranked in, financing_open, early_stage, not_confirmed, financing_closed or cancelled, null when no ranking has scored it.

score_window_label.title: Score Window Label
score_window_label.description: The window in words, null when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_band.title: Score Band
score_band.description: The band word that goes with the score, null when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_reason_count.title: Score Reason Count
score_reason_count.description: How many reasons stand behind the score, 0 when no ranking has scored the deal.

score_hidden.title: Score Hidden
score_hidden.description: True for the rows a desk holds back by default, which the book serves only with include_hidden=true.

score_own_bank.title: Score Own Bank
score_own_bank.description: True when your own bank is named as a lender on the deal, read from the stored demotion.

state.title: State
state.description: The state the deal's linked findings confirm, null when no source's quote confirmed one.

state_label.title: State Label
state_label.description: The confirmed state in words, null when state is null.

event_date.title: Event Date
event_date.description: The newest event date a source stated in its own words, as a plain date, null when none was stated.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: Why the row is on the desk's list, in the words of the desk of the team whose book holds it.

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: What is still to be financed, in the words of that desk, derived from the confirmed state, the window, the agencies and the lenders.

merged_into.title: Merged Into
merged_into.description: The deal this one was folded into after it turned out to be the same transaction, null on every standing deal.

from_pool.title: From Pool
from_pool.description: True on a deal of the shared deal pool, whose facts and research Stonewake keeps once for every workspace, while its status, its dismissed_reason and its next step are your team's own.

dismissed_in_pool.title: Dismissed In Pool
dismissed_in_pool.description: True where Stonewake dismissed the pool deal in the pool, because it was merged into another deal or set aside, so it reads dismissed in every workspace and can be neither reopened nor followed.

latest_update.description: The newest dated event on the deal's timeline whose quote confirmed a state, null when there is none.

has_unseen_update.title: Has Unseen Update
has_unseen_update.description: True when that event reached the deal after you last opened it in the dashboard, null for an API key, which records no opens.

q_matched.title: Q Matched
q_matched.description: Read with q, one entry per word or phrase of q the row holds, in the order of q, naming the first field that holds it, so a kept row says why it was kept, null on a page read without q.

V1DealSummaryOut.title: V1DealSummaryOut
V1DealSummaryOut.description: A deal-book row minus the dashboard lifecycle stamps.

error.description: The refusal, its code service_unavailable and that code's fixed message.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Why the request could not be served, in one plain sentence. Retry with backoff.

V1DetailOut.title: V1DetailOut
V1DetailOut.description: A 503 that names no code of its own, so it carries the envelope code service_unavailable beside its detail. Retry with backoff.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The research run the development comes from.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose research run this is. A key reads exactly the runs of the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it. Null on a run from before runs carried a team, which only a signed in administrator or compliance officer reads.

category.title: Category
category.description: The development's category, the attribute of its finding.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The finding's claim, as a one line headline.

value.title: Value
value.description: The finding's value, null when it states none.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Whether the cited text bears the claim out.

source_count.title: Source Count
source_count.description: How many sources the finding cites.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: The newest publication date of its sources, null when none is dated.

relevance_score.title: Relevance Score
relevance_score.description: How relevant the development is, null on a run about a natural person, which is never scored.

country_iso3.title: Country Iso3
country_iso3.description: The country the development concerns as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when unknown.

country_name.title: Country Name
country_name.description: That country's name, null when unknown.

V1DevelopmentOut.title: V1DevelopmentOut
V1DevelopmentOut.description:
A dated, cited development: a grounded research finding surfaced across
runs, headline-first, with corroboration and relevance cues.

suggestion_id.title: Suggestion Id
suggestion_id.description: The suggestion's id. Never served since 18 October 2026.

deal_id.title: Deal Id
deal_id.description: The deal a merge keeps, the one first seen.

deal_name.title: Deal Name
deal_name.description: The first deal's name. Never served since 18 October 2026.

other_deal_id.title: Other Deal Id
other_deal_id.description: The deal a merge would fold into deal_id.

other_deal_name.title: Other Deal Name
other_deal_name.description: The second deal's name. Never served since 18 October 2026.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: What the two deals share. buyer, the same buyer or borrower and the same reported value. company, the same company bound to the register, country and project, the values not compared. institution, the same agency or lender, country and value, days apart. name, the same project name and a shared agency or lender. project, the same country and the words of one project, an agency's project notice that names no buyer. value_missing, the same buyer, country and project, with no reported value on one side or both.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One plain sentence naming what matched.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the suggestion was made. Never served since 18 October 2026.

V1DuplicateOut.title: V1DuplicateOut
V1DuplicateOut.description:
Two live deals that look like one transaction. Never served since 18 Oct 2026,
because Stonewake resolves duplicate deals itself.

entity_class.title: Entity Class
entity_class.description: corporate, sovereign_or_public_body, bank, spv or fund: the class that decides which checks apply (a bank is never scored on corporate distress models). Null when no classification has run.

source.title: Source
source.description: analyst_override when your team set the class on this exposure, else the register rule that derived it: gleif_category, entity_registry, nic_entity_type, eba_transparency, pra_bank_list, uk_pillar3, fdic_call_report, elf_code, elf_code_with_bic, name_rule or default.

decided_at.title: Decided At
decided_at.description: When the analyst set it, or when the derivation ran.

derived_class.title: Derived Class
derived_class.description: The class the register facts alone derive for the company.

V1EntityClassOut.title: V1EntityClassOut
V1EntityClassOut.description:
The class the exposure's checks route on, and why. The dashboard's
person-shaped `set_by` is dropped (the transitions feed precedent).

id.title: Id
id.description: The registry id, the entity_id of the entity routes.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The entry's name as surfaces print it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The entry's kind, such as eca, multilateral, dfi, development_bank, agency, bank or trade_press.

country.title: Country
country.description: The entry's country, null for a multilateral.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: The other names the registry holds for the entry.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: The groups the entry belongs to.

location_label.title: Location Label
location_label.description: The country in words, or Multilateral for a multilateral.

V1EntityOut.title: V1EntityOut
V1EntityOut.description:
The registry row exactly as the shared EntityOut serves it (id, slug,
display_name, full_name, kind, country, aliases, groups), subclassed so the
two surfaces cannot drift; the field set is pinned by test.

code.title: Code
code.description: A stable code, today one of unauthenticated (401), forbidden (403), not_found (404), method_not_allowed (405, a method the path does not serve, so no operation declares it), content_too_large (413), validation_failed (422), rate_limited and daily_quota_exceeded (429), internal_error (500), quota_unavailable, server_busy and service_unavailable (503). New codes may be added over time.

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain text, one fixed message per code, except quota_unavailable, whose message names which of its two counts could not be verified. docs.stonewake.ai/errors lists every message.

V1ErrorBodyOut.title: V1ErrorBodyOut
V1ErrorBodyOut.description:
One refusal. Branch on code, never on message. Codes are stable, and new
codes may be added over time.

error.description: The refusal, with its stable code and message.

V1ErrorOut.title: V1ErrorOut
V1ErrorOut.description:
The /v1 error envelope every 4xx refusal carries, except a 422 (its body names
the parameter) and a 413 that arrives without a body.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: event for a single event, rollup for a group of them.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: How the row is ranked, alert, review, routine or resolution.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: The kind of register event, such as new_filing or status_changed.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The sentence the feed shows for the row.

action.title: Action
action.description: A fixed sentence naming the bank's own next step for this class of event.

group_key.title: Group Key
group_key.description: The key the group parameter takes to expand a rollup into its members.

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: When the event happened, as the register states it.

member_count.title: Member Count
member_count.description: How many events the row stands for.

citation.description: The record that evidences the row's leading event, null where the evidence is a record's absence.

V1EventRowOut.title: V1EventRowOut
V1EventRowOut.description:
One display row of the grouped feed (an event or an expandable rollup),
minus the wave-2 read-marker id.

id.title: Id
id.description: The exposure's id, the exposure_id of the portfolio routes.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

register_identifier.description: The company's leading register identifier, null when it holds none.

entity_class.title: Entity Class
entity_class.description: The monitoring class derived for this borrower: corporate, sovereign_or_public_body, bank, spv or fund. Derived deterministically from register-stated facts (the legal form code, the LEI record's entity category, the register the identifier belongs to) with an analyst override where one is set. Null when no classification has run for the node yet. Read only.

desk.title: Desk
desk.description: Your bank's own label for the desk that holds the exposure, null when none is set.

active.title: Active
active.description: False for a deactivated exposure, which include_inactive=true lists.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the exposure entered the book.

status.title: Status
status.description: green, amber, red, insufficient, not_assessed or sole_trader. A sole trader is never scored.

score.title: Score
score.description: The assessment's score, null when there is none or for a sole trader.

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Weight share of applicable signals that carry a band, including bands assumed for missing data under a conservative on_missing posture. Null when not yet assessed. Compare evidence_completeness, which counts evidence only.

evidence_completeness.title: Evidence Completeness
evidence_completeness.description: Weight share backed by actual evidence; assumed bands never count, so this never exceeds completeness. Null when not yet assessed or on assessments computed before engine v3.

seen_share.title: Seen Share
seen_share.description: Weight share of the applicable signals actually observed (evidenced or a drained register that saw nothing); gaps count against it. Null when not yet assessed.

explained_share.title: Explained Share
explained_share.description: seen_share plus the weight of gaps with a terminal verdict (no public register, or one closed to the public). Null when not yet assessed.

reachable_share.title: Reachable Share
reachable_share.description: The figure the insufficient status floor reads, the weight share of the applicable signals some connected source can serve for the company's jurisdiction that was actually observed. A signal no connected source reaches there still counts against seen_share, but never makes the company insufficient. Null when not yet assessed.

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: When the current assessment was computed, null when there is none.

top_signals.title: Top Signals
top_signals.description: The signals that weigh most in the current assessment, empty for a sole trader.

last_transition.description: The exposure's last status change, null when there is none or for a sole trader.

review.description: The standing credit review: the latest of the exposure's append only review history. Null when the exposure was never reviewed.

review_overdue.title: Review Overdue
review_overdue.description: True when the standing review's next review date has passed (UTC) on an active exposure, never on a deactivated one.

screening_id.title: Screening Id
screening_id.description: The company's latest complete screening this team can read, or null.

screening_verdict.title: Screening Verdict
screening_verdict.description: That screening's result beside the credit status and never part of it, one of red, amber, green, no_findings or incomplete, as the screening serves it.

screening_confirmed.title: Screening Confirmed
screening_confirmed.description: True when an analyst confirmed at least one category of that screening.

sanctions_name_matches_open.title: Sanctions Name Matches Open
sanctions_name_matches_open.description: Open sanctions name matches of persons the registers link to this company, from the sanctions person review queue. A name match is never a hit.

V1ExposureOut.title: V1ExposureOut
V1ExposureOut.description:
One monitored exposure with its current standing, a curated projection
of the dashboard's exposure row. status vocabulary: green | amber | red |
insufficient | not_assessed | sole_trader. The dashboard and the docs name
insufficient No score yet and not_assessed Not yet assessed. sole_trader is a
natural person's business by its register's own evidence: it is never scored, so every
assessment field is null, top_signals is empty and last_transition null,
while its identity and its credit review stay.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

charges.title: Charges
charges.description: The registered charges, live ones first, satisfied ones after them.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: The listed debt instruments in view, the soonest maturity first, empty when maturity_wall folds them.

debt_facts.title: Debt Facts
debt_facts.description: The debt position figures as filed, each with its confidence label.

debt_positions.title: Debt Positions
debt_positions.description: One card per figure, basis and consolidation, the latest filed figure leading.

derived.description: Aggregates computed from every active instrument, never changed by include_matured, bucket or the cap.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: One coverage state per section, so what was not searched is stated rather than silent.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The lender nodes the charges are bound to, in the node shape.

energy_assets.description: The company's generating units as the Marktstammdatenregister states them, null when it states none.

maturity_wall.description: The active listed instruments folded by maturity band, for a company with more than 20 of them, null otherwise or with include_matured=true or bucket.

satisfied_charges_line.title: Satisfied Charges Line
satisfied_charges_line.description: How many charges are fully satisfied, in words, null when none is.

instruments_total.title: Instruments Total
instruments_total.description: How many instruments are in view before the cap of 500.

instruments_truncated.title: Instruments Truncated
instruments_truncated.description: True when instruments was cut at 500.

matured_excluded.title: Matured Excluded
matured_excluded.description: How many matured instruments the default view leaves out, 0 with include_matured=true and on a bucket slice.

terminated_excluded.title: Terminated Excluded
terminated_excluded.description: How many listed instruments FIRDS states as no longer admitted to trading on any venue the default view leaves out, 0 with include_matured=true, which serves them after the matured ones, and on a bucket slice.

change_summary.title: Change Summary
change_summary.description: One plain sentence on what changed in the company's financing since your team's latest recorded credit review, a sentence saying no review is recorded yet where there is none, and null for a company your team does not hold or when nothing changed since the review.

V1FinancingOut.title: V1FinancingOut
V1FinancingOut.description:
The upstream FinancingOut, charges rebuilt as V1ChargeOut, bound nodes in
the /v1 node shape.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: What the finding is about, for example mandate or recent_program.

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: The finding in one readable statement.

value.title: Value
value.description: The finding's value as one plain figure or word, null when it states none.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the extraction is, high, medium or low.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Whether the cited text bears the claim out, supported, partially_supported, unsupported or unverified.

verifier_rationale.title: Verifier Rationale
verifier_rationale.description: Why the verification reads as it does, null when no reason was recorded.

novelty.title: Novelty
novelty.description: Whether the finding is new, an update of an earlier one or a duplicate.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: The ids of the sources the finding cites, each an entry of sources.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: The verbatim passages behind the finding, each capped and attributed.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: The newest publication date among the finding's cited sources, null when none is dated.

V1FindingOut.title: V1FindingOut
V1FindingOut.description:
One grounded finding: the shared FindingOut shape with supporting_quotes
rebuilt as the typed, capped, attributed V1QuoteOut list.

id.title: Id
id.description: The event's id.

iso3.title: Iso3
iso3.description: The country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when the event names none.

country_name.title: Country Name
country_name.description: The country's name, null when the event names none.

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: The kind of list event, such as a listing or a delisting.

effective_date.title: Effective Date
effective_date.description: When the event took effect, as a YYYY-MM-DD date, null when unknown.

citation_note.title: Citation Note
citation_note.description: The citation of the event in words, null when none.

citation_url.title: Citation Url
citation_url.description: The address that states the event, null when none.

source_page_url.title: Source Page Url
source_page_url.description: A page a reader can open for the event, null when none.

source_page_exact.title: Source Page Exact
source_page_exact.description: True when that page carries this country's line.

V1GeographyEventOut.title: V1GeographyEventOut
V1GeographyEventOut.description:
One reference-list happening (global fact, identical for every tenant),
its stored citation raw and the routed human-viewable page beside it.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The identifier's scheme, for example lei for a Legal Entity Identifier, or ra_ra and six digits for a registration authority number GLEIF states, such as ra_ra000406.

value.title: Value
value.description: The identifier as the register states it.

V1IdentifierOut.title: V1IdentifierOut
V1IdentifierOut.description: One register identifier: the citation-grade identity anchor.

id.title: Id
id.description: The key's id, as the dashboard's key list names it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The label the key was given at creation.

role.title: Role
role.description: Always viewer, as every key reads only.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: read, with audit for an audit export key and reports for a key that downloads report PDFs (the scopes the API checks).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the key stops working, UTC; null when it does not expire.

from_status.title: From Status
from_status.description: The status before, null for an exposure's first assessment.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

attribute.title: Attribute
attribute.description: What the finding is about, for example mandate or recent_program.

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: The finding in one readable statement.

value.title: Value
value.description: The finding's value as one plain figure or word, null when it states none.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the extraction is, high, medium or low.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Whether the cited text bears the claim out, supported, partially_supported, unsupported or unverified.

verifier_rationale.title: Verifier Rationale
verifier_rationale.description: Why the verification reads as it does, null when no reason was recorded.

novelty.title: Novelty
novelty.description: Whether the finding is new, an update of an earlier one or a duplicate.

source_ids.title: Source Ids
source_ids.description: The ids of the sources the finding cites, each an entry of sources.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: The verbatim passages behind the finding, each capped and attributed.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: The newest publication date among the finding's cited sources, null when none is dated.

finding_id.title: Finding Id
finding_id.description: The finding's id, which the deal's other fields name.

link_method.title: Link Method
link_method.description: How the finding was linked to the deal, such as seed for the finding that started it or manual for an analyst's link.

linked_at.title: Linked At
linked_at.description: When the finding was linked to the deal.

state.title: State
state.description: The state the finding's quote confirmed, null when nothing was confirmed.

state_label.title: State Label
state_label.description: That state in words, null when state is null.

state_quote.title: State Quote
state_quote.description: The passage that confirmed the state, capped like every quote, null when nothing was confirmed.

event_date.title: Event Date
event_date.description: The event date the finding's quote states, null when none was confirmed.

V1LinkedFindingOut.title: V1LinkedFindingOut
V1LinkedFindingOut.description:
A timeline entry: the finding plus its link provenance and what the state
gate confirmed on it (the state, its word, the confirming passage under the
house quote cap, and the quote backed event date; null where nothing was).

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: api_key for an swk_live_ key, user for a signed in person.

role.title: Role
role.description: The credential's role. A key is always viewer, a signed in person reads with their own role.

team_scope.description: The teams the credential's reads cover.

key.description: The calling key's own facts; null for a signed in person.

id.title: Id
id.description: The research target's id.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: The organization or person research checks.

entity_type.title: Entity Type
entity_type.description: The kind of target, such as company, agency, person or deal.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: The registry id of the target, null for a deal target or a name the registry does not resolve.

context.title: Context
context.description: Extra context research reads with the target, null when none was given.

cadence_seconds.title: Cadence Seconds
cadence_seconds.description: The cadence set on the target, in seconds.

last_run_at.title: Last Run At
last_run_at.description: When research last checked the target, null before the first run.

last_status.title: Last Status
last_status.description: The latest run's state, queued, running, done or dead, null before the first run.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: run_failed when the last run failed, screening_allowance_reached when a person's deep run waits for the monthly screening allowance, null otherwise.

next_run_at.title: Next Run At
next_run_at.description: When research checks the target next, null when it is not scheduled.

scheduled_cadence_seconds.title: Scheduled Cadence Seconds
scheduled_cadence_seconds.description: How often research checks the target in your workspace, the interval next_run_at adds to last_run_at.

V1MonitoringTargetOut.title: V1MonitoringTargetOut
V1MonitoringTargetOut.description:
One research target (an organization, or a natural person, research checks on a cadence) with
its latest run outcome and next due time. last_status speaks the queue
vocabulary (queued|running|done|dead); last_error is the pruned failure
token, never an internal string, run_failed or, for a person target's deep run
refused at the account's monthly screening allowance, screening_allowance_reached.
cadence_seconds is the cadence set on the target; scheduled_cadence_seconds is how
often research checks it in this workspace, the interval next_run_at adds to
last_run_at, which a workspace's schedule can stretch beyond the setting.

center_id.title: Center Id
center_id.description: The node whose neighbourhood this is.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The node and its neighbours in the node shape.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Every edge between the node and a served neighbour, current edges first, each cited.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when limit cut the neighbours.

V1NetworkOut.title: V1NetworkOut
V1NetworkOut.description:
The center and its neighbors in the /v1 node shape, and every edge between
the center and a served neighbor with its register citation. truncated is true
when the neighbor cap cut the neighborhood.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The node's id, which every /v1/nodes route speaks.

country_iso3.title: Country Iso3
country_iso3.description: The node's country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when unknown.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: The register jurisdiction, null when unknown.

legal_form.title: Legal Form
legal_form.description: The legal form as the register codes it, null when none is stated.

legal_form_label.title: Legal Form Label
legal_form_label.description: The legal form in words, null when none is stated.

company_status.title: Company Status
company_status.description: The company's register status as one code of a closed list, the same on every node whatever register states it, namely active, active_proposal_to_strike_off, active_receiver_manager, registered, open, in_liquidation, in_administration, administration_order, in_administration_administrative_receiver, in_administration_receiver_manager, administrative_receiver, receiver_manager_administrative_receiver, receivership, voluntary_arrangement, voluntary_arrangement_administrative_receiver, voluntary_arrangement_receiver_manager, insolvency_proceedings, in_bankruptcy, inactive, dissolved, deleted, converted_closed, closed or unknown, unknown for a wording the list does not name, null when no register states a status.

company_status_label.title: Company Status Label
company_status_label.description: The status in English words, the register's own words for unknown, null when no register states a status.

company_status_source.title: Company Status Source
company_status_source.description: The register's own words for the status, whole, for example ACTIVE from GLEIF or aktuell from the Handelsregister, null when no register states a status.

registration_status.title: Registration Status
registration_status.description: The status of the registration itself, such as an LEI's, null when none is stated.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when the registration has lapsed, so the record is no longer current.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: True for a branch, which carries its head office's legal name and the branch's host country.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: The node's register identifiers, at most 200.

identifiers_total.title: Identifiers Total
identifiers_total.description: How many identifiers the node holds.

identifiers_truncated.title: Identifiers Truncated
identifiers_truncated.description: True when identifiers was cut at 200.

records.title: Records
records.description: Every current register record of the node as a citation, newest first.

records_total.title: Records Total
records_total.description: How many records the node holds, the length of records.

registers.title: Registers
registers.description: Each register's count of records, the register with the newest record first.

branch_of_label.title: Branch Of Label
branch_of_label.description: The head office's name for a branch, null otherwise.

merged_into.title: Merged Into
merged_into.description: The node this record was joined into, another node of the same company that holds its identifiers, records and events now, null for a node that stands on its own.

V1NodeDetailOut.title: V1NodeDetailOut
V1NodeDetailOut.description: One node with its identifiers and every current register record as a citation, newest first, and each register's count. A branch also names its head office.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: The feed's rows, grouped and ordered by tier.

events_total.title: Events Total
events_total.description: How many events the node holds.

events_truncated.title: Events Truncated
events_truncated.description: True when the feed was cut.

insolvency_lookup.description: How current the German insolvency notices are for a company with a German register entry, null for any other company.

merged_into.title: Merged Into
merged_into.description: The node this record was joined into, whose feed holds its events since the merge, null for a node that stands on its own.

V1NodeEventsOut.title: V1NodeEventsOut
V1NodeEventsOut.description:
The register-events feed with honest counters, minus the caller-team
review watermark (a dashboard read marker). insolvency_lookup states how
current the German insolvency notices are for a company with a German
register entry (null otherwise), off the caller's own workspace lookups:
pending while a lookup is queued, then current with its date, and
not_requested with no timestamp for a company no person of the caller's
workspace asked about (opened in the dashboard, screened, put into a dossier
or held in the portfolio); reading it never asks for a lookup.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The node's id, which every /v1/nodes route speaks.

country_iso3.title: Country Iso3
country_iso3.description: The node's country as an ISO 3166 alpha 3 code, null when unknown.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: The register jurisdiction, null when unknown.

legal_form.title: Legal Form
legal_form.description: The legal form as the register codes it, null when none is stated.

legal_form_label.title: Legal Form Label
legal_form_label.description: The legal form in words, null when none is stated.

company_status.title: Company Status
company_status.description: The company's register status as one code of a closed list, the same on every node whatever register states it, namely active, active_proposal_to_strike_off, active_receiver_manager, registered, open, in_liquidation, in_administration, administration_order, in_administration_administrative_receiver, in_administration_receiver_manager, administrative_receiver, receiver_manager_administrative_receiver, receivership, voluntary_arrangement, voluntary_arrangement_administrative_receiver, voluntary_arrangement_receiver_manager, insolvency_proceedings, in_bankruptcy, inactive, dissolved, deleted, converted_closed, closed or unknown, unknown for a wording the list does not name, null when no register states a status.

company_status_label.title: Company Status Label
company_status_label.description: The status in English words, the register's own words for unknown, null when no register states a status.

company_status_source.title: Company Status Source
company_status_source.description: The register's own words for the status, whole, for example ACTIVE from GLEIF or aktuell from the Handelsregister, null when no register states a status.

registration_status.title: Registration Status
registration_status.description: The status of the registration itself, such as an LEI's, null when none is stated.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when the registration has lapsed, so the record is no longer current.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: True for a branch, which carries its head office's legal name and the branch's host country.

identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: The node's register identifiers, at most 200.

identifiers_total.title: Identifiers Total
identifiers_total.description: How many identifiers the node holds.

identifiers_truncated.title: Identifiers Truncated
identifiers_truncated.description: True when identifiers was cut at 200.

V1NodeOut.title: V1NodeOut
V1NodeOut.description:
The ONE /v1 node identity shape (financing and ownership reuse it for
their bound-node strips): the graph chokepoint's fields minus the internal
lifecycle `status` and the reporting_exceptions annotation dict. node_type
says company or person; a person is served only where the tenant's person
gate is open.

items.title: Items
items.description: This page's rows, in the order the endpoint states.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The most rows this page could hold, as asked or by default.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: How many rows of the whole result come before this page.

total.title: Total
total.description: The exact count of rows after filtering, across every page.

records_total.title: Records Total
records_total.description: How many records the node holds.

registers.title: Registers
registers.description: Each register's count of records, so the first page tells which registers to read.

V1NodeRecordsOut.title: V1NodeRecordsOut
V1NodeRecordsOut.description:
One page of a node's current records: one register's, or the whole
book's without connector_id (`total` counts what is paged). Every page also states
the node's records_total and each register's count, so a client learns a large
company's registers without the whole node read.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

name.title: Name
name.description: The company's name, the same name GET /v1/portfolio rows serve as label.

in_portfolio.title: In Portfolio
in_portfolio.description: True when your team holds the company.

exposure_id.title: Exposure Id
exposure_id.description: Your team's exposure of the company, null when it holds none.

assessment.description: The current assessment, null when the company is not held or not yet assessed, or is a sole trader.

entity_class_detail.description: The class this company's checks route on and why. Null when not held, and always for a sole trader.

entity_class.description: Deprecated, the same object as entity_class_detail. Every other route serves entity_class as the class itself (a string); read entity_class_detail instead.

sole_trader.title: Sole Trader
sole_trader.description: True when the register states the company to be a natural person's business (a German legal form code of the 400000 branch, GLEIF's SOLE_PROPRIETOR category, or the e.K. designation of the firm name). A sole trader is never scored: assessment, entity_class and rescore_queued are null.

removed.description: Set when the caller's team took this company off its monitored book and holds it no more: when (removed_at) and why (reason, added_in_error or ended, null when none was given). Its earlier assessments, status changes and credit reviews stay on record; adding the company again reactivates the same exposure. Null while held or never held.

rescore_queued.title: Rescore Queued
rescore_queued.description: True while a recompute of the workspace is queued or running since the current run (a confirmed screening verdict, an added company, a class pick): the status served is the previous run's and a new one follows. Null for a sole trader, which is never scored.

V1NodeRiskOut.title: V1NodeRiskOut
V1NodeRiskOut.description:
The caller-team's credit-monitoring view of one graph node: not held
(in_portfolio=false), held but not yet assessed (assessment=null), or the
full current breakdown. `name` is the graph node's label, the same source
/v1/portfolio rows serve as `label`. `entity_class` is null when not held.

root_id.title: Root Id
root_id.description: The node the chain starts at.

resolver_version.title: Resolver Version
resolver_version.description: The version of the chain resolver that composed the answer.

input_digest.title: Input Digest
input_digest.description: A digest of the inputs the chain was composed from, the same inputs giving the same digest.

params.description: The parameters the chain was composed with.

bounded.title: Bounded
bounded.description: True when the walk was cut at a bound, so further owners may exist.

min_as_of.title: Min As Of
min_as_of.description: The oldest as of date among the chain's witnesses, null when none states one.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The nodes the chain names, in the node shape.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: The upward paths, hop by hop, each cited.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: The aggregate holdings an owner reaches over several paths, only where their conditions held.

coverage.description: Whether the chain can be relied on for beneficial ownership, with the missing links named.

register_owners.title: Register Owners
register_owners.description: Every person with significant control the Companies House register lists for the root company, ceased ones included, an individual named only where person data is switched on.

V1OwnershipChainOut.title: V1OwnershipChainOut
V1OwnershipChainOut.description:
The upstream chain payload with `nodes` in the /v1 node shape. The
params echo's include_persons states whether person owners were served.

insufficient.title: Insufficient
insufficient.description: Active exposures assessed but with too little observed to score, No score yet.

not_assessed.title: Not Assessed
not_assessed.description: Active exposures with no assessment yet.

sole_trader.title: Sole Trader
sole_trader.description: Active exposures of a sole trader, which is held but never scored.

statuses.title: StatusCountsShape
statuses.description: How many active exposures read each status, every status counted, 0 included.

active_exposures.title: Active Exposures
active_exposures.description: How many exposures the active book holds.

transitions_30d.title: Transitions 30D
transitions_30d.description: Every entry of the status change feed in the last 30 days, an exposure's first assessment included.

status_changes_30d.title: Status Changes 30D
status_changes_30d.description: The status changes among them, an exposure's first assessment not counted.

reviews_overdue.title: Reviews Overdue
reviews_overdue.description: The active exposures whose standing review date has passed.

sanctions_name_matches_open.title: Sanctions Name Matches Open
sanctions_name_matches_open.description: The open sanctions name matches of persons linked to the active book, each counted once.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The id of the source the passage comes from.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: The source line to show with the passage.

passage.title: Passage
passage.description: The verbatim passage, at most 240 characters.

V1QuoteOut.title: V1QuoteOut
V1QuoteOut.description:
One capped supporting passage with its attribution (licence terms:
URL + attribution are mandatory, so both fields are non-optional).

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: The register's source id, as the records route takes it.

records_total.title: Records Total
records_total.description: How many of the node's records come from this register.

V1RegisterRecordsOut.title: V1RegisterRecordsOut
V1RegisterRecordsOut.description:
One register's current records on the node: the exact count of its rows in
`records`. GET /v1/nodes/{node_id}/records pages the register alone.

code.title: Code
code.description: rate_limited or daily_quota_exceeded on a 429, server_busy on a 503.

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain text, one fixed message per code. docs.stonewake.ai/errors lists it.

retry_after_seconds.title: Retry After Seconds
retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the next request, equal to the Retry-After header.

V1RetryErrorBodyOut.title: V1RetryErrorBodyOut
V1RetryErrorBodyOut.description: A refusal that names when to retry, a traffic ceiling or server_busy.

error.description: The refusal, with its stable code, its message and the seconds to wait.

V1RetryErrorOut.title: V1RetryErrorOut
V1RetryErrorOut.description:
The envelope of a refusal that names when to retry: every 429 and a 503 server_busy
carry retry_after_seconds beside the Retry-After header.

exposure_id.title: Exposure Id
exposure_id.description: The exposure whose review needs attention.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: The company's node id.

status.title: Status
status.description: The exposure's current status, green, amber, red, insufficient or not_assessed.

next_review_on.title: Next Review On
next_review_on.description: The date the standing review falls due.

V1ReviewDueOut.title: V1ReviewDueOut
V1ReviewDueOut.description:
One exposure whose standing review is overdue or falls due soon. status
is one of green, amber, red, insufficient or not_assessed, and disposition
one of no_action, watch_list, intensified_care or escalated, or added when the
first review of an exposure nobody has reviewed yet falls due. The owner is
not served.

id.title: Id
id.description: The review's id.

disposition.title: Disposition
disposition.description: no_action, watch_list, intensified_care or escalated, or added for the record of the day the exposure joined the book, which is never a review.

note.title: Note
note.description: The review's note, null when none was written.

next_review_on.title: Next Review On
next_review_on.description: The date the next review is due.

V1ReviewOut.title: V1ReviewOut
V1ReviewOut.description:
One credit review of an exposure. disposition: no_action | watch_list |
intensified_care | escalated, or added for the record of the day the exposure
joined the book (never a review). The owner and the reviewer are not served.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The UTC day the review dates are compared against.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: How many days ahead due_soon looks, 14.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: The active exposures whose standing next review date has passed, soonest first, at most 50.

overdue_total.title: Overdue Total
overdue_total.description: How many reviews are overdue, every one counted.

due_soon.title: Due Soon
due_soon.description: The active exposures whose review falls due within window_days, today included, soonest first, at most 50.

due_soon_total.title: Due Soon Total
due_soon_total.description: How many reviews fall due soon, every one counted.

never_reviewed.title: Never Reviewed
never_reviewed.description: How many active exposures were never reviewed.

V1ReviewsDueOut.title: V1ReviewsDueOut
V1ReviewsDueOut.description:
The reviews that need attention on `as_of` (UTC). `overdue` holds those
whose standing next review date has passed, `due_soon` those falling within
`window_days` from today, today included. Each is soonest first and capped
at 50 items, and the totals count every one. `never_reviewed` counts the
active exposures with no review.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version scoring your team's exposures, null while the built in default is live.

config.description: The configuration scoring your team's exposures.

active.title: Active
active.description: True for the version that scores your team's exposures.

config.description: The version's full configuration, frozen when it was saved.

V1RiskProfileDetailOut.title: V1RiskProfileDetailOut
V1RiskProfileDetailOut.description: One stored version WITH its full frozen config snapshot.

version.title: Version
version.description: The rubric version, as GET /v1/risk-profiles/{version} takes it.

active.title: Active
active.description: True for the version that scores your team's exposures.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: party for a deal party, country for the deal's main country.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The party's roles on the deal, empty for the country.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: The registry id of the party, null when it has none.

node_id.title: Node Id

official_lists.description: The Official lists section, first in the result. A deterministic comparison of the subject with each official sanctions list named in lists, with no search and no model call, stored when the screening ran (basis screening, as_of that moment). A screening from before list results were stored reads its own record (basis not_stored, as_of the screening's moment): every list not_checked, Not checked at the time where the list was switched on after it ran, and the comparison made when the result is read is the separate recheck block (basis recheck, as_of the read), never the record. Per list, status is listed (only on an identifier the list itself states and the subject's own register entry carries), name_match_awaiting_review (a name without an identifier, or an identifier of a register entry that was linked to the subject by name, a candidate for review and never a hit), name_match_reviewed (every name match closed by a reviewer as same_party or different_party, which never turns a name into a listing), no_entry_found (with the list edition and the check time) or not_checked (with the reason, for example a list that is switched off or was last checked more than 48 hours ago). Names match exactly on a normalised key, so other spellings, word orders and transliterations are not found. lists_compared counts the lists switched on and checked within 48 hours. A list that is not checked never reads as clear.

V1SearchHitOut.title: V1SearchHitOut
V1SearchHitOut.description:
One hit, a company or (where the workspace's person gate is open) a natural
person, as node_type says. `node_id` is the graph node id every other /v1 node
route speaks. score is a company's name-match relevance band (1.0 exact, 0.95
prefix, 0.9 token, 0.87 one typo per word, fuzzy capped at 0.85); None on
identifier hits and on every
person hit, which is never scored. Exact ignores the
spelling of the legal form (AG equals Aktiengesellschaft) and also matches a
registered other name. Hits come in rank order, not always score order. The
leading legal entities a name stands for (well known companies whose name
equals, begins with or holds the typed words) come first, then every other hit
by score, the better known company first inside a band.
legal_form_label words an ELF code. stale=true marks a LAPSED registration,
never current reference data.

the notice's reference there, how it arrived (mail_forward, an alert of one of
your bank's portal accounts; export_upload, an uploaded export) and when. Same

V1TenderReasonOut.description:

field read, stated what the notice states there, wanted what the profile asks,
matched the stated values that hit (for the deadline, the days left).

content_base64.title: Content Base64
content_base64.description: The exported file, base64 encoded; at most 700,000 bytes before encoding.

mapping.description: How each read column maps to an upload field.

ignored_columns.title: Ignored Columns
ignored_columns.description: The columns read by no field.

unknown_columns.title: Unknown Columns
unknown_columns.description: The columns your mapping names that the file does not hold.

available_fields.title: Available Fields
available_fields.description: The upload fields a column can be mapped to, reference, notice_id, notice_version, procedure_id, publication_number, form_type, notice_type, notice_subtype, published_on, buyer_name, buyer_identifier, buyer_country, contract_nature, procedure_type, cpv, place_of_performance, estimated_value, estimated_currency, tender_deadline, title, description, text_lang, source_url, lot.

counters.title: Counters

limit.title: Limit

total.title: Total
total.description: How many rows the whole file holds.

V1TenderUploadOut.description:
The dashboard preview with its rows paged: `rows` holds rows offset to
offset + limit in file order; counts, counters and total cover the whole file.

V1TransitionCauseOut.title: V1TransitionCauseOut
V1TransitionCauseOut.description:
Why the status moved, derived deterministically from the two assessments
named here (both readable at /v1/risk-assessments/{assessment_id}). kind:
added (the first assessment, an addition to the book, not a change) |
change. available: false when either assessment cannot be read, and then no
driver is claimed. stopped_scoring: how many drivers, named or counted, had
a band before and none now. rules_changed: the engine or rubric version
differs between them.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team whose book holds this row. A key reads exactly the one team it was issued for; GET /v1/me states it.

cadence.title: Cadence

last_refreshed_at.title: Last Refreshed At
last_refreshed_at.description: When the watch last refreshed the node, null before the first refresh.

queued_check_by.title: Queued Check By

loc.title: Location
loc.description: Where the failure is, the part of the request (path, query or body) and then the parameter or field.

type.title: Error Type
type.description: The kind of failure, such as missing, value_error, extra_forbidden for a query parameter the endpoint does not read, literal_error for a closed value outside its list, finite_number for a number that is not finite, such as 1e400, inf or nan, timezone_aware for a date and time without a UTC offset, or too_many_errors for the entry that counts the entries beyond the first 10.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: How the dollar sort key was reached, stated_usd when the Value is in US dollars, source_usd when the source gives a dollar figure beside it, or reference_rate when amount was converted at rate.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The figure the rule read as a plain decimal, in currency for reference_rate and in US dollars otherwise, so the dollar figure can be recomputed from published numbers alone.

currency.title: Currency

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: The reference rate exactly as its source publishes it, null unless basis is reference_rate.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: How rate is quoted, such as GBP per EUR beside the ECB's USD per EUR or SAR per USD, null unless basis is reference_rate.

rate_date.title: Rate Date
rate_date.description: The day the rate is published for, null unless basis is reference_rate.

rate_source.title: Rate Source
rate_source.description: Who publishes the rate, null unless basis is reference_rate.

rounded_to.title: Rounded To
rounded_to.description: The place the dollar figure of amount is rounded to, such as 1000000 for GBP 82m or 0.01 for an amount stated to the cent or in US dollars.

amount_min.title: Amount Min
amount_min.description: The lower end of a range as a plain decimal in the same currency, null unless the Value states a range.

rounded_to_min.title: Rounded To Min
rounded_to_min.description: The place the dollar figure of amount_min is rounded to, null unless the Value states a range.

ValueConversionOut.title: ValueConversionOut
ValueConversionOut.description:
How the dollar sort key was reached, so it can be traced and reproduced (the
api rehearsal of 31 Oct 2026, mcp-itai-7): `basis` stated_usd (the Value is in US
dollars), source_usd (the dollar figure the source gives beside it) or
reference_rate (`currency` converted at `rate`, quoted as `quote`, published for
`rate_date` at `rate_source`). `amount` is the figure the rule read, a plain decimal
in `currency` for reference_rate, in dollars otherwise, so the dollar figure is
recomputed from the published numbers alone (review rv-dealtruth of 1 Nov 2026).

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: The band, within_12m, 1_to_2y, 2_to_5y, beyond_5y or no_maturity, as the bucket parameter takes it.

currency_lines.title: Currency Lines
currency_lines.description: The nominal sums of the band's leading currencies, in words.

more_currencies_line.title: More Currencies Line
more_currencies_line.description: How many further currencies the band holds, in words, null when there are none.

WallBucketOut.title: WallBucketOut
WallBucketOut.description:
One maturity-bucket row of the wall, rendered server-side: locked label and
count line, top-currency nominal sums, the folded-currencies line. `bucket` is
the endpoint's expansion key: the row's ledger slice answers ?bucket={bucket}.
